liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1993-08-22.mtx.hansokolow.98235.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 191 min; rated 4.5/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: The audience recording has tonal issues and wavering timbre during the jam section [1]
- **gd1993-08-22.schoeps.evans-Leutbecher-townshend.82529.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1993-08-22.140173.fob.Schoeps-MK41.miller.sirmick.140173.flac.1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 187 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1993-08-22.schoeps.evans-Leutbecher-townshend.82637.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 191 min [5]. Said about its sound: Skips in the recording were minimized by approximately one hundredth of a second [5]
- **gd93-08-22.sbd.nawrocki.562.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 179 min; rated 4/5 by 70 [7]. Said about its sound: Garcia's new guitar tone remains pure and unadulterated with effects for most of the performance [10]

## Around the show

- Vanilla sky clouds rolled in from the west as Garcia mingled during the song [11]
- Weir left the stage during the tune, prompting Garcia to take over the performance [13]
- College students from Santa Clara rented vans to drive to the show from the Bay Area [16]
- Weir smashed his guitar at the start, then re-entered stage left to Garcia's glance [19]
- Reviewer considers this the best show of 1993 and possibly the last great Dead show [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-08-22.mtx.hansokolow.98235.flac16**: transferred by matrix by  hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=562 and DAUD: shnid=97076 [1]
- **gd1993-08-22.schoeps.evans-Leutbecher-townshend.82529.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans; transferred by Minor editing done by Garret Leutbecher (Audition 1.5) & Michael Townshend; source: FOB Schoeps Mk2 Omni Capsule spaced omnis (10 ft spread) in hat -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 3 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Jumper -> Oade Supply ->… [3]. Also: Garret Leutbecher and Michael Townshend edited the Schoeps recording, removing pops and clicks [3]
- **gd1993-08-22.140173.fob.Schoeps-MK41.miller.sirmick.140173.flac.1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: (FOB) Schoeps MK41 > Panasonic SV-255 > dat(48k); Transfer: dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000> wav 16/48; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6… [4]. Also: The last eight minutes of NFA and Liberty were patched from shnid 82637 [4]
- **gd1993-08-22.schoeps.evans-Leutbecher-townshend.82637.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans; transferred by Minor editing done by Garret Leutbecher (Audition 1.5) & Michael Townshend (Wavelab); source: FOB Schoeps Mk2 Omni Capsule spaced omnis (10 ft spread) in hat -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 3 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Jumper -> Oade Supply ->… [5]
- **gd93-08-22.sbd.nawrocki.562.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> CD> EAC> Cool Edit '96 (removed digipops prior to music inbeginning of d2t1 & d3t1)> CDWAV> Shorten32 [7]
